steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Hello? Who's this? I'm busy here!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Inspector, Inspector, I know where Nathan is! I'm sending you the location, it may not be correct, I'll go ahead and scout first!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Huh? No! It's dangerous, kid! Wait for us to go together—
She jumps down from a pile of garbage, her foot twists and she rolls down head over heels. Before she has time to cry out in pain, she gets up with her hands and feet and runs.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The criminal did catch Nathan first, but she didn't immediately kill him. According to the second sentence of the Flowery Scroll, Nathan should be the second person to "bloom" according to the criminal's plan.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What if there's still a chance, what if I can make it in time! If I make it, he doesn't have to die!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: But if the murderer is at the scene—
She better be, Christina has a lot to say to the Mentor. Even if she doesn't bump into her here, she will definitely catch up, she must find that white-haired Sinner.
Holding the phone, her hand is shaking violently. She's shocked by the scene in front of her, and her heart is being shaken by regret, powerlessness, and deeper anger.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Hey! Hello? Are you okay? Speak up!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Inspector... I found the scene. Sorry, I'm too late.

17:36, August 9, N.F. 113
East Bank of the Rust
"Wall of Collapse" crime scene

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: There are lots of flowers blooming. It's very dangerous around here too. Make sure everyone wears protection, and it's best to call FAC.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Before you arrive, I will do a preliminary investigation of the scene...

After hanging up the phone, Christina takes a deep breath. The dazzling Mania flowers are messing with her senses, stirring up past chaotic memories. Christina must control any potential physiological reactions. She must overcome obstacles; she can't fall here.
The dead cannot be brought back, she failed to save one person's life. What she can do now is to find the truth.
